# chronosphere_cloud_integration (Resource)

Ingests metrics from a cloud provider. The provider-specific configuration is an opaque JSON object whose structure is defined by `provider_type`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "chronosphere_cloud_integration" "gcp_prod" {
  name = "GCP Prod"
  slug = "gcp-prod"

  provider_type = "gcp"
  provider_config = jsonencode({
    service_account = {
      client_email = "scraper@my-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
    }
    metric_groups = [
      {
        project_id = "my-project"
        prefixes   = ["compute.googleapis.com/"]
      }
    ]
  })

  metric_labels = {
    env = "prod"
  }

  state = "ENABLED"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the cloud integration.
- `provider_config` (String) Provider-specific configuration as a JSON object (use `jsonencode`). Structure depends on `provider_type`.
- `provider_type` (String) Identifies the cloud provider (e.g. `gcp`). The supported set is defined by the Chronosphere API.

### Optional

- `external_connection_slug` (String) Slug of the ExternalConnection used for credentials. Optional depending on the provider.
- `metric_labels` (Map of String) Labels applied to all metrics emitted from this integration.
- `slug` (String) Stable identifier for the integration. Generated from `name` if omitted. Immutable after creation.
- `state` (String) Operational state of the integration: ENABLED, DISABLED, or PREVIEW.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
